channel.title: The Luverne Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Luverne Journal (luvernejournal.com)

item.title: Miles named ITAC February team member
item.description: ITAC honors long-term materials team member Dock Miles as February Team Member of the Month for his reliability, positive attitude and strong communication on the materials floor.

item.title: Crenshaw County crowns new Miss, Little Miss
item.description: Crenshaw County crowns eight queens, with Lauren White named 2026 Miss Crenshaw County and Grayson Mount 2026 Little Miss.

item.title: Figures holds Crenshaw community conversation
item.description: Rep. Shomari Figures meets packed Crenshaw crowd to discuss federal grants, education, healthcare and retired teachers as the state legislature reaches mid-session.

item.title: Jesus is the way to life
item.description: Drawing on Scripture, Dean Kelly urges readers to leave the broad path of destruction, embrace the narrow way of biblical truth and follow Jesus as the only way to life.

item.title: Your life can change in a moment
item.description: A viral cello video and Daniel’s ancient dream show one theme: with God, a single moment can transform your life and reveal a kingdom that will never end.

item.title: Brantley Bulldogs advance to Final Four
item.description: Brantley Bulldogs top McIntosh 75-58 to reach 2025-26 boys' Final Four, setting up a March 2 matchup with Wadley at BJCC as coach Andre Parks focuses on preparation and fan support.

item.title: NAACP celebrates Founders' Day
item.description: Crenshaw County NAACP marks Founders’ Day with Luverne dinner supporting a Foot Soldier Scholarship fund and Black History Month, featuring speakers on diversity and community.

item.title: Memories from the Opelika Hospital
item.description: An Alabama pastor recalls learning of Reagan’s 1981 shooting at an Opelika hospital and an unexpected $20 bill that shaped his reflections on suffering, gratitude and God’s gifts.

item.title: Time with God sparks change
item.description: Pastor Dunford Cole reflects on how regular time with God visibly transforms believers — from renewed minds to changed daily lives — and why true encounters with God always leave a lasting mark.

item.title: McMeans shatters corrections career glass ceiling
item.description: After nearly seven years at Crenshaw County Detention, Sondra McMeans becomes the facility’s first assistant jail administrator and first Black woman in the role.
